questions.subject: Physics
questions.stem: In Schedule 07 Question 1: During an adiabatic expansion of an ideal gas with ratio of heat capacities gamma, how is gas pressure P related to volume V?
questions.solution: In reversible adiabatic process dQ = 0, leading directly to the Poisson equation P * V^gamma = constant.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.stem: In Schedule 07 Question 36: A Carnot engine operates between temperatures T_hot = 3900 K and T_cold = 3700 K. Calculate its theoretical thermodynamic efficiency percentage (rounded to integer).
questions.solution: Carnot efficiency eta = 1 - T_cold/T_hot = 1 - 3700 / 3900 = 5%.
